tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description:
Ask a real human to verify, decide on, or improve something before your agent acts.

    Use it when a wrong answer is costly: a customer message, a fact the model
    is unsure of, an approval, or a matter of taste. A person reads the intent
    and the claim and answers accept, reject, or a refine

tools.name: get_verify
tools.description:
Read the current state of a verification. Free, never reveals a locked answer.

    verify_id: the id returned by verify_claim.
    Returns status "processing" (a human is working: wait retry_after_seconds,
    or rely on the callback), "ready" (an answer exists; service_window shows
    the window

tools.name: unlock_verify
tools.description:
Unlock a ready chain and return the human result.

    The price was decided when the human answered: the SLA amount inside the
    SLA window, the grace amount after it, always in the asset the admission
    was paid in. get_verify shows it as service_window.unlock_amount before
    you pay. Omit p

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "unlock_verify" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Unlock a ready chain and return the human result. The price was decided when the human answered: the SLA amount inside the SLA window, the grace amount after it…

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "unlock_verify" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptiior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Unlock a ready chain and return the human result. The price was decided when the human answered: the SLA amount inside the SLA window, the grace amount after it…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "verifi_info" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Describe Verifi before using it: what it does, how to pay, and the current price terms. Free and needs no arguments. Returns the service summary, how payment wo…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verifi_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
